attacks.claim: A captured delivery can be replayed within the 5-minute window. Upserts are idempotent, so the impact is limited to possibly overwriting a newer correction for the same reading.
A misconfigured secret leads to silent 401s, with only a log warning to signal it. There is no metric or alert. This is an operational nicety, not a gate blocker.
